title: Replay from a Buffer Position
statement: Let $x,w,$ and $out$ be finite Boolean words, let $p$ be an input-head position for $x$, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j\le |w|$. Starting with the replay machine in its start control, its work tape storing $w$ with the head at cell $j$, and output $out$, after $j+|w|+3$ steps it is halted, the head is at cell $|w|$, the buffer remains $w$, and the output is $out$ followed by $w$.
replaced: For every input word, input position, buffer $w$, output prefix, and head position $j \le |w|$, running the replay machine from its start control at cell $j$ for $j + |w| + 3$ steps appends exactly $w$ to the output and physically halts; only the prefix rewind, the full emission, and the halt are charged.
